city.name: Philadelphia
city.regionLabel: Philadelphia, nearby suburbs and a sensible drive

events.title: 50th Annual PMA Contemporary Craft Show
events.description: Meet 195 makers working across 13 craft and design categories at the show’s 50th edition. Browse one-of-a-kind work and buy directly from artists; enter at 12th and Arch.

events.title: BalletX Fall Series 2026
events.description: See BalletX’s fall program, including Loughlan Prior’s Prohibition-era Speakeasy and Amy Hall Garner’s Switching the Groove. The official schedule offers a Friday evening and weekend matinees; choose your performance before buying tickets.

events.title: First Friday: More Than Meets the Eye
events.description: Explore a new display about the people, tools and preservation techniques behind corneal transplantation. This free after-hours evening includes activities and a drop-in research-library tour, with limited tour capacity.

events.title: Chanticleer’s Final Weekend
events.description: Take a final autumn walk through Chanticleer before its November 8 seasonal closing. The first Saturday opens early at 8 AM. Check the garden’s date-specific parking-reservation rules when planning your visit.

events.title: Chrysanthemum Festival
events.description: See carefully trained chrysanthemums and colorful conservatory displays during Longwood’s autumn festival. Timed admission is required. November hours end at 5 PM, earlier than the garden’s October weekend schedule.

events.title: El Día de los Muertos Ofrenda
events.description: See artist Ivette Chaires’ Day of the Dead altar during its final weekend at the Magic Gardens Museum. The display is included with admission; reserve a timed ticket and leave time for the surrounding mosaic environment.

events.title: Gateway Indoor Vintage Market
events.description: Browse vintage clothing, records, furniture, collectibles and antiques at this indoor market. The organizer confirms Friday, Saturday and Sunday opening year-round, making it an easy weather-proof browsing option.

events.title: Marcel Duchamp
events.description: Explore Duchamp’s experiments across painting, sculpture, film and readymades in a major retrospective. Book a timed exhibition slot, allow extra time for queuing, and use the included general admission to explore the rest of the museum.

events.title: Pumpkinland Closing Weekend
events.description: Catch the final weekend of Linvilla’s seasonal pumpkin display. Walking through Pumpkinland is free, while activities are separately ticketed. Weekend hayrides and mazes have their own schedules; do not assume every attraction runs Friday.
events.time: Daily; Check source for activity hours

events.title: Steve Tobin: In the Light
events.description: Walk among large-scale sculptures installed across the arboretum’s landscape. Tobin’s works opened in October and remain on view for a year, offering a fall outing that combines contemporary art with gardens and woodland scenery.

events.title: Topdog/Underdog
events.description: Watch Suzan-Lori Parks’ Pulitzer-winning drama about brothers Lincoln and Booth, family rivalry and survival. This co-production with People’s Light contains mature themes and strong language; the official ticket calendar shows limited availability.

events.title: Apple Festival at Peddler’s Village
events.description: Taste apple treats, browse village shops and catch live entertainment during this two-day fall celebration. Admission and parking are free; food and attractions cost extra, and some vendors accept cash only.
events.priceLabel: Free entry; food and attractions extra

events.title: Market of the Macabre
events.description: Browse unusual art, handmade goods, antiques and curious collectibles in the cemetery. This is the rescheduled market date. Advance tickets close at noon Friday; parking is limited, so transit or rideshare is sensible.

events.title: Philadelphia Union vs. Toronto FC
events.description: Join the Union’s regular-season finale and fan-appreciation match against Toronto. The team promises discounted concessions and merchandise plus special fan experiences; buy through its linked ticket seller and allow for stadium traffic.
